manufacturer_report.body_en:
Model: Legion Pro 7 16IAX10H (Machine Type 83F5)
Serial: {{SERIAL}}
Purchase date: 2026-01
Device details read from this computer

Request: Please diagnose for possible GPU / board hardware fault and advise on warranty repair steps.

Incident summary:
Total of 6 stability incidents over 6 months, 4 with memory dumps and 2 freezes without dump.

Timeline with exact dates (timezone America/Managua):
- 2026-04-22 20:38:54 - Blue screen: driver timeout - code 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - dump module nvlddmkm.sys
- 2026-04-30 17:34:39 - Freeze without blue screen - code 0x0 - no dump generated
- 2026-07-17 11:00:57 - Blue screen: driver timeout - code 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - dump module nvlddmkm.sys - driver timestamp 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-21 10:21:28 - Blue screen: driver timeout - code 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - dump module nvlddmkm.sys - driver timestamp 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-24 14:04:46 - Freeze without blue screen - code 0x0 - no dump generated
- 2026-10-23 20:45:23 - Blue screen: display driver - code 0x116 (VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE) - dump module nvlddmkm.sys - driver timestamp 2026-02-14

Stability:
All 4 available dumps blame nvlddmkm.sys (NVIDIA graphics). Three are DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION 0x133 and one is VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE 0x116. Two additional events were freezes without a blue screen. The same failure category was observed repeatedly, which indicates the same failure category but does not by itself prove the same underlying defect as other machines. No WHEA 18 fatal or WHEA 17/19/47 corrected CPU/memory hardware errors were logged, but absence does not exclude a GPU hardware fault because TDR and watchdog timeouts are GPU-subsystem failures. A possible correlation with power transitions was observed in 3 of 6 incidents, which remains a hypothesis only and does not prove a sleep/wake cause.
The issue persists across different driver versions. Two distinct nvlddmkm.sys timestamps were seen (2026-03-04 and 2026-02-14). A downgrade to an older driver on 2026-10-23 did not resolve the problem. This persistence across versions is the strongest argument to investigate the GPU and board.

Steps already taken:
Testing with different driver versions including an older version installed on 2026-10-23.

Expected next steps from support:
Please confirm recommended Lenovo NVIDIA driver version, confirm latest BIOS, run internal GPU stress test and board diagnostics, and review TDR logs to determine if repair is needed.

Modelo: Legion Pro 7 16IAX10H (Machine Type 83F5)

Detalles del dispositivo leídos de este equipo

Solicitud: Por favor diagnosticar posible fallo de hardware de GPU / placa base e indicar pasos de garantía o reparación.

Resumen de incidencias:
Total de 6 incidencias de estabilidad en 6 meses, 4 con volcados de memoria y 2 bloqueos sin volcado.

Cronología con fechas exactas (zona horaria America/Managua):
- 2026-04-22 20:38:54 - Pantalla azul: tiempo de espera del controlador - código 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - módulo nvlddmkm.sys
- 2026-04-30 17:34:39 - Bloqueo sin pantalla azul - código 0x0 - sin volcado
- 2026-07-17 11:00:57 - Pantalla azul: tiempo de espera del controlador - código 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - módulo nvlddmkm.sys - fecha de controlador 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-21 10:21:28 - Pantalla azul: tiempo de espera del controlador - código 0x133 (DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION) - módulo nvlddmkm.sys - fecha de controlador 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-24 14:04:46 - Bloqueo sin pantalla azul - código 0x0 - sin volcado
- 2026-10-23 20:45:23 - Pantalla azul: controlador de pantalla - código 0x116 (VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE) - módulo nvlddmkm.sys - fecha de controlador 2026-02-14

Estabilidad:
Los 4 volcados disponibles señalan a nvlddmkm.sys (gráfica NVIDIA). Tres son DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION 0x133 y uno es VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE 0x116. Dos eventos adicionales fueron bloqueos sin pantalla azul. La repetición de la misma categoría de fallo indica misma categoría, pero no prueba por sí misma el mismo defecto que en otros equipos. No se registraron errores fatales WHEA 18 ni errores corregidos WHEA 17/19/47 de CPU/memoria, pero su ausencia no excluye un fallo de hardware de GPU porque los errores TDR y de watchdog son fallos del subsistema gráfico. Se observó una posible correlación con transiciones de energía en 3 de 6 incidencias, que es solo una hipótesis y no prueba causa en suspensión o reactivación.
El problema persiste en diferentes versiones del controlador. Se observaron dos marcas de tiempo distintas de nvlddmkm.sys (2026-03-04 y 2026-02-14). La instalación de una versión más antigua el 2026-10-23 no resolvió el problema. Esta persistencia en distintas versiones es el argumento más sólido para investigar la GPU y la placa.

Acciones ya realizadas:
Pruebas con diferentes versiones del controlador, incluyendo una versión anterior instalada el 2026-10-23.

Pasos esperados del soporte:
Por favor confirmar la versión del controlador gráfico NVIDIA recomendada por Lenovo, confirmar la última BIOS, ejecutar prueba de estrés de GPU y diagnóstico de placa, y revisar los registros TDR para determinar si necesita reparación.
manufacturer_report.subject: Lenovo Legion Pro 7 16IAX10H: recurring NVIDIA display crashes - nvlddmkm.sys 0x133 and 0x116

case.user_summary: Your Legion laptop has had 6 incidents over 6 months with repeated blue screens and freezes linked to the graphics system. The issue continued even after trying different graphics drivers, which suggests a possible hardware problem, but the evidence is still limited and uncertain. Please contact Lenovo support for a full hardware diagnostic, save your work and keep backups until it is checked.

findings.text: 4 blue-screen dumps attributed to nvlddmkm.sys between 2026-04-22 and 2026-10-23 out of 6 total incidents (2 additional freezes without dump on 2026-04-30 and 2026-07-24)
3x DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133) with params 0x1, 0x1e00 and 1x VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x116) with params 0xffffffffc000009a, 0x4 - both indicate GPU/display driver timeout/recovery failure

Same failure CATEGORY repeated: 0x133_ISR_nvlddmkm!unknown_function in 3 dumps (2026-04-22, 2026-07-17, 2026-07-21) with identical bugcheck params; same FAILURE_BUCKET_ID means same category, not proven same defect as other machines
Same module nvlddmkm.sys failed with 2 distinct driver timestamps: 2026-03-04 and 2026-02-14. Failure persisted across different driver versions (direction older/downgrade)
Repetition fact: 4 incidents within 90 days from 2026-04-22 to 2026-07-21 indicates clustering; total span 6 months to 2026-10-23 shows chronic not single regression
No WHEA 18 fatal hardware errors and no frequent WHEA 17/19/47 corrected errors were logged - therefore no independent CPU/memory hardware error evidence

3/6 incidents flagged as during power transition (SleepInProgress 4 on 2026-04-30 and 2026-07-24 freezes, SleepInProgress 1 on 2026-07-17 bugcheck) - this is only a hypothesis about sleep/wake involvement, not proven causation

Persistence of nvlddmkm.sys failures across driver versions and across two different bugcheck codes (0x133 and 0x116) points away from single driver bug and toward underlying GPU hardware/subsystem fault - escalate to manufacturer - this remains a hypothesis but is the strongest escalation argument
